detours.why: No doors are mapped on Steele Hall, so walks end at the path nearest its middle, on the Fairchild side of the science block; from Richardson that is round Wilder Hall, not straight up the slope.

Observatory Hill, wooded with no mapped path from its east or north side, lies between the Ivy Lane, North Park Street and Maynard Street halls and the science buildings on its west slope; walks go round it by East Wheelock Street or College Street.

The Geisel buildings (Vail, Remsen, Kellogg, Anonymous Hall) form one block with no doors mapped, and the mapped paths nearest their middles are on the north side by the Life Sciences Center; from Maynard Street and the east, walks go round the block.

No doors are mapped on New Hampshire Hall; the mapped way nearest its middle is the service path on its south side by Hallgarten, so walks north to the Green and to the arts buildings start round the back.
No doors are mapped on The Lodge; the mapped way nearest it is behind it on the south, so walks north to Hallgarten and Leverone go round by Lebanon Street.

No doors are mapped on Alumni Gymnasium or Berry Sports Center; Morton and Andres reach East Wheelock Street only by the Ivy Lane drive, so walks go out to the street and along it to the paths beside the gyms.

The Thayer engineering buildings (Cummings, MacLean, ECSC, Murdough) are one connected block with no doors mapped, and the mapped paths nearest their middles are on the inner side; from the River halls walks go round the block by Thayer Drive.
